cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：流浪汉
cards.example_en: A tired bum slept on the station bench.

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：咔嗒声
cards.example_en: A loud click came from the broken door lock.
cards.example_zh: 坏掉的门锁发出一声很响的咔嗒声。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: The shopkeeper greeted a regular client by name.
cards.example_zh: 店主喊着名字招呼一位老主顾。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: The door code is written in my notebook.
cards.example_zh: 门的代码写在我的笔记本里。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：得出结论
cards.example_en: These results let us conclude that the plant needs more sun.
cards.example_zh: 这些结果让我们得出结论：这种植物需要更多阳光。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：自信的
cards.example_en: She sounded confident when she introduced the guest speaker.
cards.example_zh: 她介绍演讲嘉宾时，声音听起来很自信。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：上下文
cards.example_en: The joke only makes sense if you know the context from yesterday.
cards.example_zh: 只有知道昨天的上下文，这个笑话才讲得通。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: Sharing mooncakes is a family custom on Mid-Autumn night.
cards.example_zh: 中秋夜分月饼是我们家的习俗。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: The scientist points out that the data still need further verification.
cards.example_zh: 科学家指出，数据仍需进一步验证。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：数据库
cards.example_en: The nurse checked the database for my vaccination record.
cards.example_zh: 护士在数据库里查了我的疫苗接种记录。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：依赖的

cards.example_en: There was no doubt that her free kick would beat the keeper.
cards.example_zh: 毫无疑问，她的任意球会打过守门员。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: The globe shows the earth with blue oceans and green land.

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology

cards.example_zh: 上坡时的最后一次努力让她追上了领先的人。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
